name: Hylo HYUSD
oneLiner: HYUSD is Hylo's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin on Solana, backed by a basket of Solana LSTs with the xSOL companion token absorbing volatility.
collateral: Diversified basket of Solana LSTs (mSOL, jitoSOL, bSOL, JupSOL)
pegMechanism: Overcollateralization (150%+) with companion leveraged token (xSOL) absorbing SOL volatility; operates on Solana (not Ethereum or a Stage 1 L2)

mintAuthority.summary: hyUSD is minted on Solana by depositing LSTs (jitoSOL, mSOL, bSOL, JupSOL) into Hylo's overcollateralized pool, with the companion xSOL token absorbing volatility under the Hylo invariant; the Hylo program authority controls parameters and upgrades.

controls.label: Hylo collateral pool program (minter)
controls.capDescription: hyUSD mints only against LST collateral deposited into the Hylo pool under the invariant that hyUSD + xSOL market value equals total collateral TVL; supply is bounded by deposited LST collateral and the 150%+ overcollateralization target.
controls.evidence: Hylo docs describe hyUSD minting from a Solana LST collateral pool governed by the Hylo invariant equation, with xSOL absorbing SOL volatility to hold the peg.

controls.label: Hylo program upgrade/admin authority
controls.capDescription: The Hylo Solana program authority can upgrade the program and administer pool parameters (collateral set, ratios); the specific authority (multisig vs governance) was not independently resolved.
controls.evidence: Hylo operates as an upgradeable Solana program; an upgrade/parameter authority governs the collateral pool, though the docs reviewed do not enumerate the controlling key.

review.evidence: Hylo documentation describes hyUSD as an overcollateralized LST-backed stablecoin minted via the Hylo pool invariant with xSOL as the volatility absorber; a Solana program authority governs parameters and upgrades.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Collateral-pool mint mechanism confirmed from Hylo docs; the Solana program upgrade/admin authority (multisig/governance) was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the Hylo Solana program upgrade authority and pool parameter admin (multisig vs governance) before raising confidence.
